title: Verbs with Two Participles
goal: Choose the regular or the short participle for imprimir, freír, proveer and elegir.

items: I can use the regular participle after *haber* with *imprimir*, *freír*, *proveer* and *elegir*.
I can use the short participle (*impreso*, *frito*, *provisto*, *electo*) as an adjective.
I can use the new words for printing, frying and supplying.
